description: Ministry of Transport & Civil Aviation - Amending the Item No. 2 of the Schedule to the Order Published in Gaz.Ex.Ord. No. 1957/14 of 08.03.2016
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with the acquisition of land for the development of domestic airports. It provides detailed geographical coordinates and descriptions of the land parcels being acquired in Bandarawela. The content focuses entirely on land matters (acquisition for a specific purpose) and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories like legal, commercial, or public service matters.
